blocks.task_summary: Write equations of the vertical and horizontal asymptotes of f(x)=(2x-1)/(x+1).
method_path: set denominator x+1=0 to obtain vertical asymptote x=-1
identify horizontal asymptote y=2 from ratio of leading coefficients

blocks.task_summary: Sketch rational function with asymptotes x=-1, y=2 and intercepts at x=1/2, y=-1.
method_path: sketch rational function with two branches in opposite quadrants
draw asymptotes x=-1 and y=2 with correct asymptotic approach

evidence.basis: rational function shape with two branches in opposite quadrants, with two correctly positioned asymptotes and asymptotic behaviour shown A1; axes intercepts clearly shown at x=1/2 and y=-1 A1A1. [3 marks]

blocks.task_summary: Use the graph from (b) to solve the compound inequality 0 < f(x) < 2.
method_path: read from graph: 0 < f(x) < 2 when x > 1/2

evidence.basis: x > 1/2 A1. Accept alternative notation. [1 mark]

blocks.task_summary: Solve the absolute-value inequality by sketching |f(x)| or finding critical points.
method_path: sketch |(2x-1)/(x+1)| or solve 2x-1=0 to identify critical points x=1/2 and x=-1/2
accepted_alternatives: EITHER sketch |(2x-1)/(x+1)| and read solution; OR solve 2x-1=0 algebraically to find critical points and test intervals

evidence.basis: EITHER attempts to sketch |(2x-1)/(x+1)| (M1) OR attempts to solve 2x-1=0 (M1). Note: Award M1 if x=1/2 and x=-1/2 are identified. THEN x < -1/2 or x > 1/2 A1. [2 marks]
